changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetTypeError_backup') BEGIN DROP TABLE integration.ExecutionAssetTypeError_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetTypeError_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeError_backup]( [ExecutionID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [SynchedAssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [SourceID] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [ErrorMessages] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeError_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [ErrorCode] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeError] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
